bias_targets.methodology: Estimating pre-training data language distribution by generating random sequences and identifying their language using fastText, and evaluating few-shot reasoning performance across multiple languages using the Multilingual Grade School Math (MGSM) benchmark.

Evaluating model performance on culture-specific benchmarks (e.g., Japanese cultural understanding datasets like NIILCQA, JMMLU, and JAQKET) to measure how heavily models are biased toward Western-centric or English-centric concepts.
